name: Damon Maitsu
source:
There was never a doubt in Damon's mind that he was destined to be the Ultimate Debater. From an early age, Damon would argue with anyone that tried to confront him. This led him to learn how to argue from any position in any topic. Such frequent confrontations left Damon isolated from his peers, further leading him down the path of ignoring others solely to train his talent, with the hope that one day he will be admired by everyone for his skill.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1348301282310807556]official description[/url]]
